scope.execution: Read-only source, saved diff and existing receipt review. No Git, Cargo, compiler, bake, GPU/native process or target write was performed. This receipt is the sole file written.

PLMP6.result: No new blocking defect found in literal/palette decoding, lossless interning or legacy compatibility.
checks: Full 69-byte within-batch keys preserve signed zero, all attribute seams, first-occurrence order, unique unreferenced vertices and ordered u16 draw indices. Invalid source indices fail remapping.

Modes 1/2 retain exact 28-byte normal/tangent/handedness frames, 36-byte prefix and 5-byte tail. Palette selection is deterministic and strictly cheaper including headers; size ties remain literal mode 0.

Decoder checks encoded length, cumulative checked logical-literal bytes, vertex/frame counts, whole storage runs and u16 palette capacity before decoded vertex allocation. It borrows palette bytes, validates unused frames for finite values, checks every frame reference and retains the neutral codec's complete finite-field validation.

Writer and reader enforce the existing 536870912-byte expanded literal budget including batch metadata, 69-byte stored vertices and u16 index runs. Compression cannot enlarge this logical allocation contract. Index budget/run checks precede index allocation.

Independent literal PLMP3/4/5 fixtures retain old layout, conservative pre-v5 caster default and v3 matte default. PLMP6 rejects unknown modes, malformed palettes, truncated runs, nonfinite frames and invalid references.

Compiler fingerprints already include the props record version and executable identity. No format/currentness exemption, schema topology change or shader change was added. Encoding statistics remain compiler reporting metadata; reused archives have no invented original-slot count.

Geometry7.result: Roof endpoint correction is bounded to owning wall spans.
checks: Production collision and render callers share LevelSurfaces::wall_solid_slices. A span's midpoint chooses its roof owner; exact span endpoints are evaluated against that same owner, preserving explicit wall heights and floor offsets.
This recovers missing endpoint/ridge slabs without borrowing a taller neighbouring room, widening collision tolerances or changing authored source geometry. Generic closure API compatibility remains.
Focused tests retain exact ridge bits and body/support witnesses. Final recovered weather occupied-union, navigation and semantic comparisons remain separate package acceptance requirements.

Solver16.result: Chosen-grid targets and bake positions share a strict placement contract.
checks: Shared placement checks finite positions, room/floor/roof ownership, walkable floor clearance, authored wall bounds and opaque/closed-solid clearance.

Default lattice is retained when all rooms already have valid probes. Otherwise at most 64 deterministic quarter-cell phases preserve every initially covered room and require a newly covered room; covered-room count then sorted per-room counts choose the first best distribution.

Probe target and bake positions use the same lattice. Origin/cell/dimensions and target position bits are checked before bake. PLPF3 zero-selected-source aligned sidecar semantics remain intact; solver revision 16 invalidates old physical caches through existing keys.

The source Demo witness selected origin [-8.834395,-3.6294875,-111.30767] and valid per-room counts [15,15,10,174,14,36,77,16,8,18,4,16,1592,12], with both existing runtime support assertions passing. That focused fixture does not replace final fully resolved prepared-field/native validation.

atlas_and_package_budgets.result: Current owning constants, renderer capacity, diagnostics and canonical current-policy paragraphs agree.
checks: Full retains 1024px pages, 16 texels/m and existing gutters/endpoints/packing; Medium retains 1024px, 12 texels/m and eight pages. Legacy Low retains eight 512px pages. Renderer capacity aliases the owning Full constant and allocates resident pages/groups.

The measured Hallows padded footprint requires ten unchanged Full pages. Demo's ten-page, two-group HDR payload is 335544516 bytes, explaining the explicit 25% typed record increase from the preserved old rejection. This is a changed typed safety budget, not an unchanged guard.

Ordinary entry, aggregate, binary, decoder page/edge/group and KTX shape guards remain distinct and enforced. More contribution groups must still fit the typed byte cap; ten pages do not authorize arbitrary total memory.

Both diagnostic eight-page assumptions now use the shared ten-page capacity with meaningful page and receiver boundary controls. Config max_pages remains part of the content key. No map-name, camera, quality-density, brightness or provenance exception was found.

ghost_validator.result: Coplanar projected triangle support removes the centroid false positive while retaining unsupported, offset and centre-hole rejection.
checks: All triangle vertices must satisfy the existing face-plane tolerance. Projected clipping requires positive face overlap and an individual triangle containing the actual face centre; disconnected bounds cannot bridge a centre hole.

The conservative one-supported-face rule remains for closed-roof collision spans. Current Demo test now requires zero confirmed geometry errors and no reported joints; the obsolete accept-known-wall-defect branch was removed.

accepted_limits: The bounded probe phase search cannot guarantee coverage of every room or playable runtime point when no feasible phase exists. It preserves initially covered room presence, not every original sample position. Final prepared-field/visibility checks, including the lower Pit rooms, remain required.
Ghost validation is a conservative face-centre support heuristic, not proof of complete face coverage or watertight mesh topology. A small valid centre patch can satisfy it.

Pre-existing LightmapsMeta::validate accumulates chart width plus height for its coarse coverage check. It does not prove summed chart area or disjointness. This unchanged pre-overhaul limitation is not used as an overlap proof; existing shape/count/byte checks still bound allocation.

Encoded and logical-literal record ceilings are not native process RSS or GPU residency ceilings. Runtime Vertex storage, vector growth, compiler temporaries and GPU allocations require actual memory measurements.

Independent old-capacity frame-palette measurements predict 340854707 encoded prop bytes per variant and 1035943642 aggregate archive bytes, leaving 37798182 bytes below 1 GiB. These predictions are not final PLMP6 package acceptance.
